summary:
I accept T8 round 10 at 3b0a0be. I found no violations, and every acceptance item that can be checked before J1 is met with numbers I reproduced.

Branch state:
- git status is clean and origin/task/T8 equals HEAD (3b0a0be).
- The diff against b4523aa holds only M, A and D entries, all inside T8's scope (D8, D10, D13, F12, F13, tests). No renames.
- No stray files are tracked (no octave-workspace or similar).
- Trial merges of task/T8 into task/T5 and into the work-branch head both have 0 conflicts.
- On the merged T5+T8 tree, the three figures tests pass.

Tests:
- Whole suite, run by me: 27 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped (the regression test, MWEC_REGRESSION unset), 306 s.

Decision (e), face-boundary heights (realised_section_data.m, module_levels, lines 139-151):
- The sampled heights are unique([body.planes; brep.vertices(:,3)]), each taken at the height itself and at the margin on either side.
- The docstring states the limit: a change between two sampled heights of the same type is not resolved.
- My test confirms it. With n_z = 5, a hollow band [0.031, 0.067) inside one cell is resolved when its two ends are given as brep vertices or as body.planes: void area 0.1669456 against the closed form, difference -5.6e-17.
- With no face heights the band is missed (void area short by 0.0223), which is the documented limit.
- The round-9 stand-in case (box thin shell, a 0.0353 m band between the ballast_top plane and the void top, n_z = 7) is now exact: void area 6.876839719783476e-2 against closed form 6.876839719783452e-2, difference 2.4e-16.

Two key numbers re-derived by hand:
- [1 2 1 2] case: void area = 1.02 + 0.024 + 0.03 + 0.736 = 1.81, and the hole is 0.8 x 0.03 = 0.024. The test prints 1.809999999999997 and 0.024.
- joint_step jog: |x| = R - d = 1.5 - 0.1005 = 1.3995 and 1.5 - 0.2005 = 1.2995. The test prints 1.3995 to 1.2995.

Rules:
- A grep of the changed files for shape assumptions and old names finds one hit only: a control point of a rational circle in a test oracle.
- No new numeric gates: the tests use contract I3 (1e-7) and stated rounding bounds.
- Volume is counted once: the polygons tile the section within 8.9e-14 on the stand-ins, and my per-region areas match the closed form within 2.2e-14.
- Names follow rule 10, and the role 'shell' follows the owner's terms.

Deferred, each with a reason:
- The dispatch.m line-24 call goes to J2 (decision f).
- build_config config.shell goes to T11 (decision b).
- _graph/CODE_MAP.md goes to T12 (contract section 4).
- XZ/YZ sections with metrics are J1 work; see spec issues.

Not done in Octave: the figures are not rendered (AGENTS section 6), so the owner confirms them in MATLAB.

Whole suite (octave --no-gui --quiet tests/run_tests.m, no MWEC_REGRESSION): 27 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped, 28 total, 306.4 s.

test_realised_section_gap, both [1 2 1 2] variants (changes as body.planes and as brep vertex z): void area 1.809999999999997 against closed form 1.809999999999997, difference 0. Groups meet at adjacent floats at 0.02, 0.05 and 0.08. Hole area 0.024 against 0.024. Outer loop less holes against void polygons: -8.74e-16. Horizontal boundary [-0.8 -0.5; -0.4 0.4; 0.5 0.8] at each change. Hand derivation of the closed form: 1.02 + 0.024 + 0.03 + 0.736 = 1.81.

Other topology changes, each with an exact area check: one to two at 0.05 (void difference 0); two to one at 0.3 (2.2e-16); one to two and back, a material island (hole 0.36 exact, outline less hole -1.17e-15); two changes in one cell at three height pairs (at most 1.1e-16). Strip tiling within 8.9e-16 in every case.

test_realised_section_data on the stand-ins (8 cases, both modes): ballast top deviates at most 3.55e-15 m from z_ballast (I3 bound 1e-7). Void bottoms at z_ballast deviate at most 4.4e-16 m. Polygon areas against the closed-form section: at most -8.88e-14 (e.g. 11.999999999999911 against 12). 0 omitted heights. joint_step jog |x| 1.399500 to 1.299500, equal to R - d by hand: 1.5 - 0.1005 and 1.5 - 0.2005.

Decision (e), my band test on a mock with a linear half-width, n_z = 5: band [0.031, 0.067) with its ends as brep vertices or as planes gives void area 0.1669456 against closed form 0.1669456 (difference -5.6e-17). Void z_lo is 0.031 bitwise and z_hi is the float below 0.067. Without face heights the band is missed (-2.23e-2), which is the documented limit.

Decision (e) on a stand-in: box thin shell, n_z = 7, a 0.035285 m hollow band between the ballast_top plane (0.43918808) and the void top inside one cell. Void area 6.876839719783476e-2 against closed form 6.876839719783452e-2 (difference 2.4e-16).

Decision (d): joint_step kept. On the box precast with t = [0.08 0.12], solid module 3 and n_z = 3, the outline has 2 jog segments at |x| 0.8796 to 0.9196, equal to 1 - d2 and 1 - d1 within 8 eps. The single air region spans modules [1 2]. Outline area 3.23056 against closed form, difference -7.1e-15.
Rule 12, ballast level: data.z_ballast == design.z_ballast in every case. Ballast polygon top within 4.4e-16 of z_ballast (my box thin shell at z_ballast = -0.83).

Rule 12, drawn boundaries: in plot_optimised_cross_section with realised, draw_density_strips finds 0 crossings of the realised outline at all 5 interior module edges (box 2, cylinder 3, thin shell), so it draws no separator. The thin-shell stand-in bodies have 0 horizontal faces at those heights, so no line is drawn without a face behind it.

Deletions: D8 (compute_inner_profile.m, plot_inner_spline.m, the squeezes in plot_modular_precast, plot_steel_solve and stage_animations, GIF 3 removed). D10 (compute_strip_equivalent_density.m and the config.shell branches in properties_2d; an identity change because build_config:279 always sets []). D13 (build_silhouette_profile.m). grep finds no remaining reference in src, validation, tools or tests.

Orchestrator decisions: (a) extract_midplane_profile kept. (b) build_config config.shell deferred to T11. (c) I3 bound with deviations printed. (f) dispatch.m line 24 recorded and deferred to J2. (g) one U-shaped CCW inner loop per height in the mock, simple, with y = 0 cut [0.4, 0.8] on each side. (h) every topology change tested with exact areas.

Contract conformance: F12 signature and fields (polygons, void_outlines, outline, plan, strip_panels, omitted, z_ballast, edges, waterline_z, status, status_lines; body frame plus vs). F13 signatures. Consumed fields exist: F10 check.failed and reason; S8 modules V_uhpc, V_air, t; rho.air and rho.ballast; F3 eval_bspline_curve; F4 slice_bspline_surface; F6b body_section. Error IDs use the existing mwecmass:figures namespace.

Shape-assumption grep (sqrt(.*pi, pi*r, compute_rmin, R_eq, cos_alpha, L_k, max_slope, homothetic, z_fill, rho_core and similar) on the changed files: one hit only, a control point of a rational circle arc in the test oracle of test_section_y0_crossings.m.

spec_issues: AGENTS rule 12 (on main, newer than base b4523aa) says the owner reviews XZ (y = 0) and YZ (x = 0) sections of the realised C1 bodies with the rule-12 metrics printed beside them. Contract F12/F13 give only the y = 0 elevation and the plan sections, and no figure prints those metrics. This belongs to the J1 checkpoint (HANDOFF next steps item 3). I did not enforce it on T8.

tests/README.md: Spec errata 2 (1e9f700, 12:55 UTC, after T8's base) made this file shared, in the order T0 -> T0c -> T0d -> T5 -> T8. T8's row edit is its last commit, but it is not rebased on T0d (merged) or T5 (accepted). Trial merges with origin/task/T5 and with the work-branch head have 0 conflicts. The orchestrator should handle it at J2, like the dispatch.m line under decision (f).

plot_modular_precast draws dotted grey module-edge reference lines over x_range (hull +-0.30 m). At equal-t joints they cross the air where the body has no face: on the cylinder precast stand-in, 2.799 m of each 3.6 m line lies over air, at each of the 3 interior edges. I read these as annotations like the waterline, not drawn boundaries. Whether rule 12 counts them is for the orchestrator or the owner to decide.

Robustness note for plot_optimised_cross_section with realised: draw_density_strips draws no module-edge separator on the realised outline only because it skips profile segments shorter than 1e-12 m in z. The F12 outline jumps 2 x margin = 7.1e-15 m across each module edge. Measured: 0 crossings at all 5 interior edges tested, which conforms to rule 12 (the thin-shell bodies have 0 horizontal faces there). A change to that pre-existing helper would bring lines back without a face behind them. If the orchestrator wants this explicit, the change belongs to whichever task next edits draw_density_strips.
